steps.en: Clone the repo and install it into a Python 3.10 env with torch 2.4, xformers and flash-attn
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，在 Python 3.10 下装好它和 flash-attn

steps.en: Launch it with torchrun, a resolution config and your prompt
steps.zh: 用 torchrun 带上分辨率配置和提示词启动

steps.en: Draws the first frame from your prompt with the bundled FLUX.1-dev image model
steps.zh: 先用随包的 FLUX.1-dev 图像模型按提示词画出第一帧

steps.en: Denoises up to 129 frames conditioned on that frame, the text and a motion score
steps.zh: 以这一帧、文本和运动分数为条件，去噪生成最多 129 帧

steps.en: Decodes the latents with the HunyuanVideo VAE and writes an H.264 MP4 under samples/
steps.zh: 经 HunyuanVideo VAE 解码，写出 H.264 MP4

value.en: A ~5 s clip from one command on your own GPU, with the training code that produced the weights in the same repo
value.zh: 在自己的 GPU 上一条命令出一段约 5 秒的视频，而且产出这套权重的训练代码就在同一个仓库里

sources: https://github.com/hpcaitech/Open-Sora README Quickstart > Installation (conda create -n opensora python=3.10; pip install -v .; xformers==0.0.27.post2; flash-attn)

README Model Download (huggingface-cli download hpcai-tech/Open-Sora-v2 --local-dir ./ckpts); Hugging Face file list of hpcai-tech/Open-Sora-v2 (Open_Sora_v2.safetensors, flux1-dev.safetensors, flux1-dev-ae.safetensors, hunyuan_vae.safetensors, google/t5-v1_1-xxl, openai/clip-vit-large-patch14)

README Text-to-Video Generation (torchrun --nproc_per_node 1 --standalone scripts/diffusion/inference.py configs/diffusion/inference/t2i2v_256px.py --save-dir samples --prompt "raining, sea"; num_frames 4k+1 and less than 129)

configs/diffusion/inference/plugins/t2i2v.py (img_flux from ./ckpts/flux1-dev.safetensors), configs/diffusion/inference/256px.py (model Open_Sora_v2.safetensors, ae hunyuan_vae, motion_score, num_frames=129, fps_save=24)
